info.title: Courtside API
info.description:
FastAPI surface for the Courtside job API.

Video analysis runs asynchronously on a worker. Processing time depends on the
footage, model, and options; upload bytes go directly to object storage. The flow is:

    POST /v1/uploads              -> job id + presigned URL(s)
    PUT  <presigned url>          -> phone uploads straight to object storage
    POST /v1/uploads/{id}/complete -> finish multipart uploads only
    POST /v1/jobs/{id}/start      -> queued
    GET  /v1/jobs/{id}            -> poll phase/progress, or take the webhook
    GET  /v1/jobs/{id}/report     -> session facts + signed artifact URLs

Interactive docs live at /docs.

post.summary: Reserve a job and get a presigned upload URL
post.description:
Step 1. The video is PUT straight to object storage, not through this API.

Pass `multipart: true` with `size_bytes` for a resumable chunked upload --
on cellular that is the difference between retrying one 32 MiB part and
re-sending the whole match.
Reissue signed URLs within the original reservation's lifetime.

get.description: List completed multipart parts and ETags for interrupted device uploads.

post.description: Step 1b, multipart only. `parts` carries the ETag each PUT returned.

Step 2. Returns immediately; the analysis runs on a worker.

Omit options.model to use the configured OpenRouter Qwen3.8 27B default.
The selected model is saved in options.model before queuing, so a deployment
change cannot switch an already queued job to a different default model.
Use options.max_clips=3 for a preview; latency and provider charges vary.

get.description:
Step 3. Poll every few seconds and back off in the background.

Optional signed webhooks use a durable outbox; polling is still needed for recovery.

delete.description: Hide results immediately and queue live-store erasure, including object versions.

get.description:
Step 4. Session facts inline, plus signed URLs for the artifacts.

`report.html` is fully self-contained (CSS, keyframes and clips are embedded)
so it renders in a WKWebView / WebView straight from the signed URL.

size_bytes.title: Size Bytes
size_bytes.description: Required for a resumable multipart upload; omit for a single PUT.

multipart.title: Multipart
multipart.description: Resumable chunked upload. Strongly recommended on cellular.

api_key.title: Api Key
api_key.description: Shown once. Store it now; only the hash is kept.

eta_s.title: Eta S
eta_s.description: Rough seconds remaining, running jobs only.

model.title: Model
model.description: Optional OpenRouter vision model ID. Omit to use the server's DEFAULT_MODEL (qwen/qwen3.8-27b out of the box). Overrides must be in the operator's ALLOWED_MODELS. The resolved model is returned in the queued job's options.model.

max_clips.title: Max Clips
max_clips.description: Cap the clips analyzed. 0 = the whole video. Use 3 for a limited preview; processing time and provider charges vary with footage, model, and options.

pose.title: Pose
pose.description: Run pose overlays; requires an operator-enabled pose image.

JobOptions.title: JobOptions
JobOptions.description: Analysis knobs, mapped 1:1 onto `courtside` CLI flags.

JobSummary.title: JobSummary
JobSummary.description: The numbers a mobile client shows without downloading the full session.

webhook_url.title: Webhook Url
